criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: All nine rendered and mostly in a world; 5 the best frame; 1, 3 and 7 competent. 6 a clock on a plaque against plain sky with nothing of Fort Davis; 4's left half flat concrete and sky with mannequins and no shade band; 9 a yellow sliver under the front bumper; 2 a blank disc on a flat wall with no window light; 1 a boxy bus with its arm out in a traffic lane; 7 a halo around the headline. Raster SCHOOL BUS and STOP text on 1, 5, 7 and 9.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One noon world, one accent used only for the platform, one type system, the bus with its arm state. Exteriors and limestone interiors alternate as a mild strobe; the bus is absent from five frames and 6 sits outside the world.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; the 2 set back holds as a floor; c39 only beside c40; Valenta never joined; quotes match tt_alpha.txt word for word. Deductions: 6's hook 'not a two hour day' is looser than c34; 1's dek compresses c12; 8 omits c41's rise; the caption's Abbott line (c31) is not in the first comment's id line.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, who decided and where, concrete stakes on 7 and 8, and a real step on 9. The cover leads with the 2025 vote and the new fact sits in the dek.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover poses the no and 2 pays it; the turn at 3, the count at 5, 8 a strong penultimate punch. 4 could fold into 3; 5's hook a stat row.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain, specific and Texan; house rules hold; apostrophes straight in source. 5's stat row and the attribution scaffolding read like a wire story.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat, but a vehicle hero carried through the deck ending on a Texan beside it repeats no. 41, and no. 38 was a TEA deck.

one_sentence_fix: Re-shoot frame 6 as a place (the clock under the walkway's edge beam over a sunlit entry with the rimrock on a lower-third horizon) and frame 4 with the walkers stepping out of the walkway's shade band, and change frame 6's hook so it no longer implies a two-hour school day.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A clock on a plaque against plain sky; no ground, horizon or Fort Davis.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back and lower so the clock hangs from the walkway's edge beam with the rimrock on a lower-third horizon behind a sunlit entry.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The left half a dead zone; mannequins on a blank slab; no shade band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera under the walkway's edge so its shade band crosses the foreground; fill the left with the oak's canopy and shade and gritted concrete.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A yellow sliver under the front bumper; the parent's head reads as a helmet; no shade pool at the kerb.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Fix or hide the fender mesh; another head preset; the oak's shade pool at her feet.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A blank disc on a flat wall; no window light.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A tall window bay at the right raking light across the chairs.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A boxy bus with its arm out in a traffic lane among low-poly cars.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Park the bus at the kerb with the door open, crop it larger, dust and panel detail on the flank.
